pr_title: Bluetooth: Controller: Fix regression in Observer

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: Controller: ASSERT when scanning
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
When scanning using the BT shell, two different asserts were triggered: 
```
ASSERTION FAIL [0] @ WEST_TOPDIR/zephyr/subsys/bluetooth/controller/ll_sw/nordic/lll/lll.c:503
```
and
```
ASSERTION FAIL [0] @ WEST_TOPDIR/zephyr/subsys/bluetooth/controller/ll_sw/nordic/lll/lll.c:473
	lll_preempt_calc: Actual EVENT_OVERHEAD_START_US = 31555
```

**To Reproduce**
`bt scan on` when using the BT shell. 

**Expected behavior**
Expected to be able to scan without asserts. 

**Impact**
None

**Logs and console output**
N/A

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Commit SHA or Version used: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/59107

Using the nRF5340 with the hci_rpmsg sample with nrf5340_cpunet_iso-bt_ll_sw_split.conf on the netcore and the audio shell on the appcore.

**Additional context**
Found during UPF.
comments:
The assertion on line 503 indicate program/ISR stack overflow or stack corruption.

Assigned low priority to this issue, and will revisit again once some of the controller changes related to re-introducing the feature to skip radio events due to prepare callback latencies in #59801

review_comments: The issue that fixes; should we add a compile configuration for it in CI to avoid it happening again?
